JABVOX_DATA_EXPORT.TITLE: Data export
JABVOX_DATA_EXPORT.SUBTITLE: Sync this account's data to your own external database in real time.

EXPLAIN.TITLE: How it works
EXPLAIN.BODY: Connect your database (PostgreSQL, MySQL or MariaDB), choose which modules to export, and Jabvox will create and keep the tables up to date automatically. Every change in the app (messages, notes, activities, calls, custom fields) is sent to your database in real time.
EXPLAIN.ONE_DB: Each account can connect a single external database.

JABVOX_DATA_EXPORT.EMPTY: You haven't connected an external database yet.
JABVOX_DATA_EXPORT.SCHEMA_BUILT: Tables created/updated in the external database.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.PASSWORD_KEEP: Leave empty to keep the current one
FORM.ALLOW_PRIVATE: Allow private network (only if your database is on a trusted internal network)

MODULES.TITLE: Modules to export
MODULES.HINT: Choose which information is sent to your database. Core modules are always included because everything else relates to them.

CORE.LABEL: Core (leads, campaigns, activities)
CORE.DESC: Leads, campaigns, typifications, activities and custom fields.

CONVERSATIONS.LABEL: Conversations and messages
CONVERSATIONS.DESC: WhatsApp and other channels, messages and private notes, with their activity.

CALLS.LABEL: Calls (click to call)
CALLS.DESC: Manual call logs by agent and lead.

DIALER.LABEL: Predictive dialer
DIALER.DESC: Dialer campaigns, contacts and calls with their agent and lead.

CUSTOM_TABLES.LABEL: Custom tables
CUSTOM_TABLES.DESC: Multi-row custom table records (advisories, cases…) by lead.

PRODUCTS.LABEL: Products and sales
PRODUCTS.DESC: Products, orders, currencies, discounts and taxes.

DELETE.TITLE: Remove the connection
DELETE.MESSAGE: Syncing will stop. Data already in your external database is NOT deleted. Continue?
